pass_a_gloss: §14 dual gloss (Armenian-via-French sense) ≠ Pass B running English. Theme: Naked without shame; childlike innocence.
pass_b_english: Adam and Eve — such is the name of the woman — were naked and they were not ashamed, for they were innocent and had only pure thoughts like those of children; ([[naked … not ashamed >> Bible:Gen 2:25]]) nothing entered their mind and intelligence that could give birth in the soul to evil desires and shameful movements.

It is that then they kept the integrity of their nature, for what had been breathed into them at the moment of creation was a breath of life. Now so long as this breath kept its intensity and its force, it sheltered their thought and spirit from evil. Therefore they were not ashamed if they embraced and exchanged innocent caresses, like children.
